title: Orion 5.0 release readiness
brief: The release manager for the Orion mobile app, Lorenzo Baptiste, wants a readiness page for the 5.0 release, as of 2026-10-16, for the go/no-go meeting on 2026-10-22 at 10:00. The target release is 2026-10-27. Right now 5 of 9 release criteria are met, with 8200 beta testers active. Under "Readiness checklist" show all nine with current value, required value and status: Feature complete, yes, yes, met; Open P1 bugs, 0, 0, met; Open P2 bugs, 6, at most 5, not met; Beta crash-free sessions, 99.4 percent, at least 99.5 percent, not met; Accessibility audit, passed on 2026-10-09, pass, met; Languages complete, 14 of 16, 16 of 16, at risk; Load test at 3 times peak, passed, pass, met; Rollback rehearsed, yes, yes, met; App store submission, scheduled for 2026-10-20, submitted by 2026-10-21, on track. Under "Gaps to close", each with an owner and due date: open P2 bugs, Hannah Weiss, 2026-10-21; crash-free sessions, Ibrahim Sesay, 2026-10-21; the two missing languages (Thai and Hebrew), Chloe Dubois, 2026-10-20. Under "Decision": we recommend a conditional go if all three gaps are closed by 2026-10-21, and otherwise slipping the release by one week to 2026-11-03. People will read this on their phones.

edit.request: Open P2 bugs are now down to 4 and beta crash-free sessions are 99.6 percent, so both criteria are met. That makes 7 of 9 criteria met.
